title: Claude finds new weaknesses in two cryptographic research targets
friendlyTitle: Claude helped find weaknesses in two test encryption systems
summary: Anthropic says Claude Mythos Preview helped improve an attack on HAWK, a candidate post-quantum signature scheme, and found a faster attack on a reduced-round version of AES. The company stresses that neither result breaks deployed production systems, and it released papers, demonstration code and a new cryptanalysis benchmark.
friendlySummary: Anthropic used Claude to improve attacks on a future encryption candidate and a weaker research version of AES. The findings do not break the encryption used in today’s production systems.
whyItMatters: The work shows that advanced agents can contribute to specialised mathematical security research, but also that costly autonomous searches produce many failed attempts alongside successes. Cryptography teams may gain a powerful testing tool, provided findings are independently verified and disclosed responsibly.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI may help experts test important security methods faster. Human specialists still need to check every result carefully.
